name: grid-says-open-engine-says-no
prompt:
On Mt. Moon B2F (map 61, CAVERN tileset) the live engine refuses the step (25,11) -> (25,12) every single time, in both directions, yet the extracted per-cell collision grid marks BOTH tiles walkable, and the lane can stand on each tile individually. A previous operator concluded from symptoms like this that 'the collision grid is wrong in 842 of 1,440 cells' and rewrote the grid parser - which made navigation worse.

What game mechanism actually explains a refused step between two individually-walkable tiles, why can no per-cell grid ever express it, and which source of truth should the lane trust when the reference and the engine disagree?
